author: Inside Edition
description: A dog adoption center in Columbus, Ohio, has created a program to ensure that their adoptable dogs have a place to call home for the holidays. It’s called Holiday Sleepover. Before Thanksgiving and Christmas, they welcome volunteers to take shelter dogs so they aren’t alone in the shelter. Once the holidays are over, the volunteers can return the pups or adopt them. It’s a way for pups to have a comforting place to stay, even if it’s temporary. Inside Edition Digital’s Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Volunteers Can Open Their Doors to Shelter Dogs For The Holidays
